Cortina d'Ampezzo

The Dolomites, host of the Winter Olympics in 1956 and 2026.

Plan a trip to Cortina d'Ampezzo

In short

Cortina d'Ampezzo at a glance.

Cortina d'Ampezzo sits in a wide valley ringed by the Dolomites, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It hosted the 1956 Winter Olympics and co-hosted the Winter Olympics of 2026 with Milan.

Region
Veneto, Italy
Ski area
Dolomiti Superski
Nearest airports
Venice (about 2 hours), Innsbruck (about 2 hours)
Best for
Skiing with views, long lunches, ski touring

Who is it for?

Skiers who care as much about the view and the lunch as the run, and couples who want an Italian mountain town.

When to go?

Winter for skiing; summer for hiking, via ferrata and the high passes of the Dolomites.

How do you get there?

About two hours by car from Venice Airport or Innsbruck Airport.
